title: Stop hoping reviewers catch bugs
summary: Stop hoping reviewers catch bugs: a Claude Code plugin checks every commit before the PR goes to GitHub.
body: Stop hoping reviewers catch bugs: a Claude Code plugin checks every commit before the PR goes to GitHub.

Our PRs kept landing with errors in them. The fix was one Claude plugin: a backpack of tools and rules Claude loads every session. Now every commit triggers it, it verifies and checks that everything works, and only then does the PR go up.
Plugins are guardrails. The code is correct before anyone else has to review it.

I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is the real setup my team uses.
Built with @claudeai @github

Which plugin would you build? Comment PLUGIN with your idea.
